scope: Focused post-generation persistence correction; provider setup unchanged
fixture: Read-only eight-contribution Conversation on November 11, 2026 (7).ink; one additional response admitted in memory

comparison.baseline: Original ResourcePair and submission-save implementations loaded from git HEAD 72ebce52e18e737645ca4b134370f18d86986684; shared current native editor/preparation in both runs
comparison.after: Working-tree generation tracking, capture and scheduling changes
comparison.durableAdapter: Compiled existing native-document-store router with isolated temporary filesystem; requests relayed by Chrome DevTools; temporary store removed after run

longestObservedTaskMs.note: Whole browser tasks overlapping admission-to-durable completion; the initial task also includes preceding preparation/admission. Not an isolated persistence-only task timer.

paintEvidence.method: Chrome devtools.timeline Paint events following dcp-admitted user-timing marks. The native view reveals the appended contribution before capture. This measures browser painting, not physical monitor presentation.

mutationAudit.path: Text, structural, standoff and Block-property editing
mutationAudit.boundary: CanonicalRepository.commit / commitInline, including inline, split, list/task, structural and full-admission routes
mutationAudit.tracking: Existing incoming ownership/location evidence followed for touched records before and after publication; no repository enumeration or snapshot on ordinary edits

mutationAudit.path: DCP contribution admission, Entities, Relationships, Glosses and interpretations
mutationAudit.boundary: controller boundedStructuralTransaction -> shared repository commit; native semantic services and Gloss edits also commit native records
mutationAudit.tracking: Root linkedAnnotations, source standoff properties, contributed descendants and retained definition owners advance the owning Document generation
Monotonic generation increases even when content returns to previously saved bytes; conservatively dirty until another Save

mutationAudit.boundary: Native admission, command imports and record-batch operations converge on commit
mutationAudit.tracking: Record batches streamed through recordOperations; ownership inspected on both sides, including newly admitted and removed resources

mutationAudit.path: Placement-only changes, named relations and retained definitions
mutationAudit.tracking: Both previous and new owners counted; unmounted retained content remains tracked. Reference occurrence changes do not dirty their source solely because it is referenced
Rare conservative provenance generation invalidates all resource save baselines. Legacy repositories without enriched ownership evidence use repository revision conservatively
No generation changes unless persisted native state is committed. ReadState remains a read-only-by-contract API; raw mutation bypasses are not supported
Separate persisted store, not serialized into native Document; Document definitions and mention/relationship records remain covered by native commits

saveSemantics: Capture and native encoding remain synchronous; the returned frozen snapshot is associated with generation N before any asynchronous I/O.
Successful receipts acknowledge only N. Current generation is compared with N without serialization. Pending bytes and N survive unknown-outcome recovery; stale receipts remain rejected.
Native session rechecks generation after awaiting the coordinator to avoid clearing an edit between promise continuations.
Commit-triggered Dialectic saves catch up newer edits, yielding before each capture. Already satisfied queued contribution saves skip recapture. Manual Save remains one generation per action.
Pending/unsaved status starts immediately. Durable success is only reported after persistence confirmation. Failures stop catch-up and retain recovery/error state.
Two animation-frame callbacks give foreground content a paint opportunity. Hidden tabs use a task; suspended frames have a bounded 250 ms fallback. Disposed queues do not start capture.
workerAssessment: Not implemented. Snapshot structured cloning measured about 107 ms, versus about 112 ms for encoding. Off-thread encoding alone would retain the dominant ~527 ms main-thread capture and introduce a near-equivalent clone/transfer cost; no meaningful net improvement demonstrated.
limitations: Single focused before/after samples, with mounted and unmounted controls; headless Chrome timings are not guarantees of user-visible latency.
Admission uses the same current canonical implementation for the paired comparison; no admission speedup is claimed.
Capture still walks/validates the full native resource and remains a ~0.5 second main-thread task on this fixture. Painting first does not eliminate that remaining cost.
Filesystem timings include the isolated native-store service and DevTools request relay, not the user's full application/Cavern workload.
Flint 25,000-character trusted-input benchmark checks regression, not a claim that generation tracking accelerates typing.
Serial provider-conversation setup remains a separate, unchanged ~2–3 second follow-up issue.

checks: Exactly one capture/encoding per successful save; repeated dirty reads do neither
Text and structural mutations, placement-only changes, programmatic batches and detached retained definitions advance generation
DCP Entity/Relationship/Gloss/interpretation/source-mark admission, Undo/Redo and native round-trips
Edits during I/O and between acknowledgement/completion remain dirty; submission save catches up and avoids a third duplicate save
Unknown outcomes, preflight failures, stale completions, interrupted writes and recovery preserve the captured generation
Paint-before-save, suspended-frame fallback, pending state through durable completion, disposal and coalescing
Existing save destinations, collision handling, manual Save/Save As and Dialectic presentation protection
Real Flint typing, Backspace, Undo/Redo, split/Enter: zero typing snapshots and stable unrelated Cells
